messages:
leah_cs: Novaforge finished smoke tests. During partner load (~850 rps) they saw sporadic 503s from eu-west. Theyre asking for a timeboxed regional QPS bump + IP allowlist for CDN partner Streamline. Also flagged renewal as at-risk; demo Thu 14:00 UTC. Can ops provision? I can share logs.

omar_ops: Ack. Need the CDN CIDRs, target qps per region, and desired ttl.

leah_cs: CIDRs: 192.0.2.0/24 and 2001:db8:beef::/48. Request: eu-west -> 1300 qps, ap-northeast-1 -> 350 qps, ttl 48h. Demo Thu 14:00 UTC. Renewal in 12 days; customer worried about latency spikes.

trent_sre: I'll provision a transient allowlist + timeboxed rate window. Plan: pin route to low-latency quant family for demo, schedule KV warmup 30m prior, and add route-level traces. Example internal API used:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/internal/provision \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"cidrs": ["192.0.2.0/24", "2001:db8:beef::/48"], "regions": {"eu-west": 1300, "ap-northeast-1": 350}, "ttl": 172800 }'
```

provision-bot: Job 2026-05-10_12:00 initiated by trent_sre; created route eu-west-novaforge-burst-1766667000

omar_ops: Trent - apply now and DM revocation epoch so AM can update the customer. I'll keep the on-call loop open during demo.

trent_sre: Applied. Autorevoke (UTC epoch): 1766833400. Audit log: /internal/logs/provision/1766667000.txt. Route pinned to small-quant-3; fallback policy active to keep p95 token latency <140ms. KV warmup scheduled T-30m.

cass_account: Logged renewal risk in Gainsight and added enablement play: post-demo 1:1, 7-day usage check, and a follow-up lab showing batching/caching tweaks. We'll capture feedback during demo (latency variance, peering diagnostics).

leah_cs: Perfect, thanks all. I'll send prep notes and the feedback form to the customer. If demo succeeds we can propose a short Dedicated pilot to stabilize capacity. :thumbsup:
